notes: Leaf ids are permanent (l1.l2.l3 kebab). L1 and L2 grouping is data and may be regrouped without renaming a cell.
Only L3 cells hold documents. L0 (storyline), L1 and L2 are derived, read-only views.
Node names never contain '&' or the word 'or'.
core.default is the 24-cell star set. Each archetype is default plus its extras.
feeds is an informative index computed from installed brief contracts. The shipped catalog does not store it; contracts are owned by the consuming packages (DEFAULT).
links are the C1 required citations: the downstream cell's Because must cite the active version of each listed upstream cell, when both cells are in scope.

marketplace.label: Marketplace
marketplace.note: focus.segment.next holds the other side of the market

tree.name: Context
tree.question: What is true outside and inside the company today?

tree.name: Aspiration
tree.question: Why do we exist and where are we going?

tree.name: Focus
tree.question: Where do we play, for whom, with what?

tree.name: Advantage
tree.question: Why do we win and how do we earn?

tree.name: Identity
tree.question: How are we recognised, named, heard and seen?

tree.name: Capability
tree.question: What must we be able to do, and with what resources?

tree.name: Execution
tree.question: What do we do now, how do we measure it, and what could stop us?

cells.question: How big is the reachable market, counted in a unit you can check?

mustContain.hint: what is counted: buyers, seats or spend
the number you can reach inside the horizon
how the number was derived, with its source

cells.question: Which shift in the market makes now the right moment?

mustContain.hint: what it does to the need or the alternative

cells.question: What job is the core customer trying to get done, and what hurts today?

mustContain.hint: the job in the customer's words
the event that makes them look for help now

cells.question: Who decides, how do they buy, and from which budget?

mustContain.hint: the steps from interest to payment
the budget line the money comes from

cells.question: What does the customer use today instead of us, and why does it appeal?

mustContain.hint: the named alternative, doing nothing included
why it is good enough for them

cells.question: What do current alternatives leave unsolved, and why is it still open?

mustContain.hint: a finding or user message showing it

cells.question: What can we do today that is hard for others to copy?

mustContain.hint: who else has it, and why few do

cells.question: Which limits shape every choice we make?

mustContain.hint: the number or rule that bounds it

cells.question: What do we do, for whom, and why does it matter?

mustContain.hint: what we do, as a verb phrase

cells.question: What does the world look like when we have succeeded, and by when?
Which beliefs guide us even when they cost something?
Which behaviors do we expect, and which do we refuse?

mustContain.hint: how you can tell it is happening

cells.question: What measurable position do we aim to hold, and by when?

mustContain.hint: what the target covers and excludes

cells.question: What must be true at the end of this year to stay on the long-term path?

mustContain.hint: the year-end target, with a number
how it steps toward the long-term target

cells.question: Which category do we tell buyers we belong to?

mustContain.hint: the categories we get confused with

cells.question: What do we stand against inside that category?
Who exactly do we serve first, and who do we turn away?

mustContain.hint: the segment, specific enough to find

cells.question: Which segment comes next, and what triggers the move?

mustContain.hint: the evidence that starts the move
what we must change to serve them

cells.question: What exactly do customers get, and what outcome does it produce?

mustContain.hint: product, service or both, and how it is delivered

cells.question: What do we deliberately not offer, and where do we send people who want it?

mustContain.hint: where we send people who want it

cells.question: Where do we sell first, and where not yet?

mustContain.hint: places we do not serve yet

cells.question: Through which channels does the core segment find and buy from us?
How does a stranger become a customer, and at what cost?

mustContain.hint: the steps from stranger to customer
the acquisition cost or effort, estimated

cells.question: Why do customers stay and grow with us?
What do we promise the core segment that the alternative does not deliver?

mustContain.hint: the segment it is made to

cells.question: What evidence backs the promise, what is still missing, and what must we never claim?

mustContain.hint: claims we must never make, quoted

cells.question: What makes our way different, and why is it hard to copy?

mustContain.hint: why it is hard to copy

cells.question: What advantage compounds over time, and by what mechanism?

mustContain.hint: the point where it starts to hold

cells.question: What do we charge for, how much, and against which anchor?

mustContain.hint: the price, or the range being tested
what the buyer compares the price to

cells.question: What does one unit earn, and which lever moves it?

mustContain.hint: the lever that moves it most

cells.question: What single idea should people remember us by?

mustContain.hint: the idea, in a few words

cells.question: How would people describe us as a person, and what are we not?

mustContain.hint: one behavior that shows the traits

cells.question: What are we called, how is it written, and what does it mean?

mustContain.hint: what the name means or stands for

cells.question: How are products, plans and features named against the master name?

mustContain.hint: branded house, house of brands or endorsed

cells.question: What change in the world do we describe, what is at stake, and what is our way through?

mustContain.hint: what happens to people who ignore it

cells.question: How do we sound, and which words do we never use?

mustContain.hint: words and moves we never use, quoted

cells.question: What should our look feel like, what is its signature, and what do we avoid?
Which images do we use, which never, and where do they come from?
Which capabilities must be world class for the strategy to work?

mustContain.hint: the bar it must clear, testable

cells.question: Which critical capability is missing, how big is the gap, and when do we close it?

mustContain.hint: how far we are from the bar
the date and route to close it

cells.question: What do we build ourselves, and why?

mustContain.hint: why we build it rather than buy it

cells.question: Who do we rely on, what do they give us, and what is the risk?

mustContain.hint: what happens if they change terms

cells.question: Would we buy a capability, what would trigger it, and what is the limit?
How do we deliver the offer, to what standard, and who owns it?
Which technology is strategic, and which is commodity?

mustContain.hint: technology we own and invest in

cells.question: Which roles exist, who holds them, and who do we hire next?

mustContain.hint: the next role to fill, and when

cells.question: How is the team shaped, who decides what, and on what rhythm?
How is the company funded, how long does it last, and what comes next?

mustContain.hint: the next funding step and its trigger

cells.question: How do we split time and money across the bets?
What is the one bet we are making now, what should it produce, and when do we kill it?
What are we deliberately not doing now, and when do we look again?

mustContain.hint: when or on what signal we look again

cells.question: Which milestones mark progress, by when, and with what evidence?
What do we release next, to whom, and through which channel?
Which one number shows we deliver value, and what is the target?
Which inputs move the north star, with which targets and owners?
What could kill the strategy, how likely is it, and how bad would it be?

mustContain.hint: low, medium or high, with a reason

cells.question: What do we do about each top threat, and who owns it?

contradictions.rule: no item appears in both Offer and Not
Next is not the Core segment restated
no quoted Never word appears in Narrative or Promise
no quoted Never-claim phrase appears in Promise or Narrative
Annual Date is on or before Long-term Date
the largest Split share goes to the active Bet
